capabilities: Create basic, reverse, and cloze flashcards as Markdown notes
Review cards with FSRS spaced-repetition scheduling
Organize cards into decks and subdecks via subfolders
Suspend cards or override deck settings through frontmatter
Adopt existing notes by adding Front/Back sections or cloze markers
disambiguation: It stores flashcards as ordinary Markdown notes rather than exporting to a separate flashcard app; the manifest calls it 'Anki-style' but all scheduling happens inside the vault.
extras: Multi-device sync requires enabling Obsidian Sync's 'Sync all other types' on every device; review history lives in per-device .rememberlog files that must not be deleted. The plugin makes no network requests.
motivation: Built for reliable use across synced devices; the README states this as its design goal.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spaced repetition, so studying notes for long-term memory requires external apps or manual tracking.
summary: Flashcard plugin that stores each card as a Markdown note with FSRS scheduling, cloze and reversible cards, folder-based decks, and local review logs.
